docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Welcome to our final core use case. You’ve mastered the voice and digital patient journeys; now, we tackle high-stakes clinical support. When a patient needs urgent coverage for a critical procedure, the human-AI partnership is vital. Let’s build the future of agent empowerment.

Key Learning

In high-stakes healthcare, AI is about augmentation. You will learn how to leverage context preservation (passing data from the AI Agent to the Human Agent) and the AI Assistant to drive down Average Handle Time (AHT), ensure clinical accuracy, and build lasting patient trust.

The PodID Discipline

Always replace XXX with your assigned 3-digit ID (e.g., 001, 002). Your naming convention must start with the prefix Pod followed by your PodID (PodXXX). If you do not follow this convention exactly, you will overwrite your neighbor's work. Stay disciplined with your naming convention!

docs.title: Phase 1: AI Assistant Provisioning
docs.text:
Architectural Note: We are optimizing our architecture by utilizing a single, multilingual AI Assistant to serve both English and Spanish queues. This demonstrates the scalability of Webex Contact Center AI, as the assistant dynamically leverages language context passed from the voice flow.

In this phase, you will provision the "Brain" of the agent-assist experience. We will build the master AI Assistant and assign it to the respective Knowledge Base.

Prerequisite

Ensure you have downloaded the source document for the Knowledge Base. Right-click the link below, select Open in New Tab, and save the file to your Desktop folder as UseCase3_CumulusHospital_AIAssistant_KB.

📄 Download Knowledge Base Document

docs.title: 1.1 Create the English Knowledge Base
docs.text:
1. Login to Collaboration Control Hub with your admin credentials.

  2. Navigate to Collaboration Control Hub > Contact Center > Overview. Scroll down to the Quick Links section and open Webex AI Agents. You are now in the AI Agent Studio.

  3. Navigate to the third tab on the left labeled Knowledge.

  4. Click the black + Create Knowledge Base button in the upper-right corner and enter the following information:

    Field Value Name PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistantCumulus (Replace XXX with your PodID) Description Pod XXX UseCase3 Cumulus AI Assistant KB EN

    Click Create.

  5. In the Knowledge Base configuration page, click Add Source in the top-right corner, select Files, and click Add file.

  6. Select the document from your desktop folder named: UseCase3_CumulusHospital_AIAssistant_KB

  7. Click Process file.

  8. Click Close and keep processing.

Syncing in Progress

The source will show as Processing for a couple of minutes. Once it is ready, the status will change to Updated.

If it is still syncing, continue to the next step — it will complete in the background.

See how to configure

docs.title: 1.2 Create the AI Assistant
docs.text:
1. In the AI Agent Studio, navigate to the second tab on the left labeled AI Assistant Skills.

  2. Click the black + Create skill button in the upper-right corner, select Start from scratch, and click Next.

  3. Enter the following information:

    Field Value Skill Name PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistant - (Replace XXX with your PodID) System ID PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistant Goal You are the AI Assistant for Cumulus Hospital, serving as a real-time assistant for human agents. Your mission is to empower agents by analyzing bi-directional conversations to provide policy-validated intelligence during BCBS coverage inquiries. Your objective is to reduce agent cognitive load and deliver a seamless, high-quality patient experience with first-call resolution.

    Click Create.

  4. In the Skill configuration page, in the Profile tab enter the following in the Instructions box:

    1. You should ask the agent for the patient_name.

2. Conversational Analysis: Actively listen to and analyze the bi-directional 
   conversation. Identify the BCBS Policy Code and the Clinical Procedure 
   (MRI, X-Ray, Blood Test, or Ultrasound) mentioned by either party, both 
   values are mandatory BCBS policy code and procedure.

3. Real-Time Intelligence: Immediately surface policy-validated data from the 
   Knowledge Base, including coverage percentages and pre-authorization 
   requirements, so the agent can inform the patient accurately.

4. Suggested Responses: Offer concise, natural-language scripts that agents 
   can adapt. Keep all responses under 3 sentences to ensure clarity and 
   speed during live calls.

5. Form Delivery Workflow: If pre-authorization is "Required," ask the agent 
   for customer phone number and perform [send_form] action to send SMS 
   message with pre-authorization form URL.

6. Ask the agent to consult the patient if any other form is required.

7. Form Retrieval: If any other insurance form is requested, ask the name of 
   the form and perform [send_form] action again, you should have patient 
   name, patient phone number.

8. Compliance & Accuracy: Always prioritize data from the Knowledge Base, 
   including hospital procedures, working hours, locations and info requested 
   by either party.

9. Continuous Improvement: Learn from agent feedback loops to improve the 
   relevance, accuracy, and personalization of your suggested responses.

    Click Save changes.

  5. Go to the Knowledge tab. In the knowledge base dropdown, select:

    Field Value Knowledge Base PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistantCumulus

    Remember to replace XXX with your PodID

    Each student has their own Knowledge Base. Selecting the wrong one will break another student's lab.

    Click Save changes.

  6. Go to the Language tab and confirm English is selected.

    See how to configure steps 1 - 6

  7. Go to the Actions tab and click the + New action button. Configure it as follows in the Update Action page:

    •General Information

    Field Value Action Name send_form Action Description This automated action triggers an SMS delivery to the patient's mobile device. It is designed to provide immediate access to clinical documentation. Action Scope Slot filling and fulfillment See Example - General Information

    Slot Filling — Input Entities

    The following entities are the variables that the AI Assistant must capture from the live conversation before executing the send_form action. Click + New input entity for each entity below: use the arrow > to navigate from Entity 1 to Entity 6:

    Entity 1 — form_nameEntity 2 — patient_nameEntity 3 — phone_numberEntity 4 — languageEntity 5 — policy_codeEntity 6 — procedure_name Field Value Name form_name Type String Description Name of the form required, captured by the AI Assistant. Entity Examples Click +Add, enter an item, and repeat for each additional entry Patient Registration Form · Insurance Claim Form · Authorization Form · Medical Records Release · Formulario de Autorización · Formulario de Reclamo de Seguro · Formulario de Liberación de Registros Medicos · Formulario de Registro de Paciente Setting Required Agent Review Required No See Example - Entity 1: form_name

    Field Value Name patient_name Type String Description Patient name captured by the AI Assistant. Entity Examples Click +Add, enter an item and repeat Mary · Andrew · Mattew · Thomas · Charlie Setting Required Agent Review Required No See Example - Entity 2: patient_name

    Field Value Name phone_number Type String Description Patient mobile number to send SMS with forms, captured by the AI Assistant. Entity Examples +17863738922 Setting Required Agent Review Required No See Example - Entity 3: phone_number

    Field Value Name language Type String Description The language should be obtained from the call itself, where the flow should pass english or spanish as a variable. Entity Examples Click +Add, enter an item and repeat en-US · es-US Setting Required Agent Review Required No See Example - Entity 4: language

    Field Value Name policy_code Type String Description Patient policy code, captured by the AI Assistant. Entity Examples Click +Add, enter an item and repeat BCBS-101 · BCBS-202 · BCBS-303 Setting Not Required Agent Review Required No See Example - Entity 5: policy_code

    Field Value Name procedure_name Type String Description Patient's procedure name, captured by the AI Assistant. Entity Examples Click +Add, enter an item and repeat MRI · X-ray · blood test · ultrasound · Ultrasonido · Rayos X · Resonancia médica · examen de sangre Setting Not Required Agent Review Required No See Example - Entity 6: procedure_name

    Webex Connect Flow Builder Fulfillment

    Field Value Select Service PodXXX_LTRCCT2001_CUMULUS Select Flow UseCase3_Cumulus_Send_Form

    Click Save.

    See Example - Webex Connect Fulfillment

  8. Save changes: Click Save changes

  9. Publish: Click Publish, enter V1 as the comment, and click Publish again.

docs.title: 1.3 Test & Validate — The "Aha!" Moment
docs.text:
Use the built-in Preview tool in the AI Agent Studio to simulate a live chat.

  1. Inside PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistant select Preview in the upper-right corner and Start a chat and verify:

    • Patient Name Capture: The assistant asks the agent for the patient's name.
    • Policy & Procedure Recognition: The assistant identifies the BCBS Policy Code and the Clinical Procedure from the conversation.
    • Real-Time Intelligence: The assistant surfaces coverage percentages and pre-authorization requirements from the Knowledge Base.
    • Form Delivery: The assistant triggers the [send_form] action and sends the correct SMS with the pre-authorization form.
    • Language Consistency: The entire interaction remains in English.
    Test Script — English Role Message 🤖 Prompt Hi, how can I help you? 👤 User I need help with MRI with policy BCBS-101 🤖 Prompt For MRI under BCBS-101 policy, coverage is 70% and pre-authorization is required. May I have the patient's name and phone number to send the pre-authorization form via SMS? 👤 User Sophie 🤖 Prompt Thank you, Sophie. Could you please provide the patient's phone number so I can send the MRI pre-authorization form via SMS? 👤 User Enter your phone number (include the + country code) 🤖 Prompt The MRI pre-authorization form has been sent to Sophie's phone number. Please check if the patient requires any other insurance forms or assistance. 👤 User I need also the patient registration form 🤖 Prompt I can send the Patient Registration Form to Sophie. Could you please confirm the patient's phone number to send the form via SMS? 👤 User Enter your phone number (include the + country code) 🤖 Prompt The Patient Registration Form has been sent to Sophie's phone number. Please let me know if there is anything else you need assistance with. ° See how it works

  2. Session Inspection: Go to the Sessions tab inside the AI Assistant skill page. Review the last session to confirm how the Knowledge Base data was retrieved and how the send_form action was performed.

    See how it works

Operational Note — Language Toggle Required

Since we are using a single AI Assistant to serve both English and Spanish queues, you must manually toggle the language setting to test each language within the AI Agent Studio.

  1. In the PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistant page, navigate to the Language tab. Change the language to Spanish, click Save changes.

    Configure Spanish Language

  2. Spanish Chat Simulation — follow the exchange below:

    • Patient Name Capture: The assistant asks the agent for the nombre del paciente.
    • Policy & Procedure Recognition: The assistant identifies the Código de Póliza BCBS and the Procedimiento clínico from the conversation.
    • Real-Time Intelligence: The assistant surfaces coverage percentages and pre-authorization requirements from the Knowledge Base.
    • Form Delivery: The assistant triggers the [send_form] action and sends the correct SMS with the pre-authorization form.
    • Language Consistency: The entire interaction remains in Spanish.
    Test Script — Spanish Role Message 🤖 Prompt Hola, ¿cómo puedo ayudarle? 👤 User ayuda para hacer un ultrasonido con póliza BCBS-101 🤖 Prompt Para el procedimiento de ultrasonido con la póliza BCBS-101, la cobertura es del 70% y se requiere preautorización. ¿Podría proporcionarme el nombre del paciente y su número de teléfono para enviarle el formulario de preautorización por SMS? 👤 User Caro 🤖 Prompt Gracias, Caro. Para enviarle el formulario de preautorización para el ultrasonido, ¿podría proporcionarme también su número de teléfono móvil? 👤 User Enter your phone number (include the + country code) 🤖 Prompt He enviado el formulario de autorización para el ultrasonido a su número de teléfono. ¿Necesita que le ayude con algún otro formulario o trámite relacionado con su seguro? See how it works

  3. Session Inspection: Go to the Sessions tab inside the AI Assistant skill page. Review the last session to confirm the Knowledge Base data was retrieved, the send_form action was performed, and the language was Spanish.

docs.title: 1.4 Revert to English Configuration
docs.text:
Required Step

Once your Spanish testing is complete, you must revert the AI Assistant to its primary language configuration to ensure it is ready for queue integration.

  1. In the PodXXX_UseCase3_AIAssistant page, navigate to the Language tab.
  2. Change the language back to English, click Save changes, then click Publish.
  3. In the comment field, enter V2 and click Publish again to finalize the revert.

Success

Your AI Assistant is now correctly configured to serve both English & Spanish queues.

docs.title: Phase 4: The "Live" Patient Journey — English Testing
docs.text: In this phase, you will validate the end-to-end patient journey. You will simulate a live call, experience the seamless hand-off from the Triage AI to the Human Agent, and witness the AI Assistant in action.

docs.title: 4.1 English Path Validation
docs.text:
Step 1 — Agent Login

Log in with your assigned Agent credentials in the Agent Desktop.

🔗 The URL is found in Collaboration Control Hub > Contact Center > Overview > Quick Links > Desktop. Copy this link and paste it in the Google Chrome profile for your agent.

Step 2 — Agent Desktop Preferences

Field Value Team PodXXX_Cumulus Handle calls using Desktop

Click Save and Continue.

See how to configure

Set your agent status to Set as Idle (all channels) : select as reason: Break.

See how to configure

Step 3 — Initiate Call

Step 3.1: Dial your assigned Channel number from your mobile device or Webex App. (you can find it under the lab access instructions in the getting Started session).

🔗 You can use your cell phone or log in to the Webex App using the additional user assigned to your POD to make the call.

Note: For detailed guidance, refer to the Getting Started section.

Step 4 — Language Selection

When the IVR prompts for language, select English.

Step 5 — Triage Interaction

Triage Script — English

  • Request an MRI (you can also request: Blood Test, Ultrasound, or X-Ray)
  • Provide your name: Example: "Caro"
  • Provide policy code: BCBS-101
  • The AI Agent will transfer you to the human agent queue.

Step 6 — Agent Desktop Reception

Set your agent status to Set as Available (all channels) and the call will be answered automatically.

See how to configure

Best Practice

Immediately mute both your mobile device and your Agent Desktop to avoid audio feedback loops.

  • Virtual Agent Transfer Summary: In the AI Assistant menu, click View Summary in the popup. Review the Triage summary of your conversation with the AI Agent.
  • Transcript Review: Open the IVR Transcript to review the line-by-line history, then open the Live Transcript and keep it visible.

Step 7 — Real-Time Assist & Form Delivery

Live Interaction Script — English # Who Action 1 🖥️ Agent Click Get Assistance in the AI Assistant chat. 2 🖥️ Agent Unmute Agent Desktop and say: "Hello Caro, my name is [Agent PodID]. I see you want to schedule an MRI with policy code BCBS-101, is that correct?" 3 📱 Mobile Unmute mobile and say: "Yes, that is correct." 4 🤖 AI Assist Observe suggested response: "Inform Caro that her BCBS-101 policy covers 70% of the MRI cost. Let her know pre-authorization is required. Ask for her phone number to send the form via SMS." 5 🖥️ Agent Read the suggested response and ask: "Is it okay to send the pre-authorization form to the number you are calling from?" 6 📱 Mobile Unmute mobile and say: "Yes, that is okay." 7 🖥️ Agent Copy the phone number from the top panel and paste it into the Real-Time Assist chat. Observe the [send_form] action trigger. 8 🖥️ Agent Ask: "Did you receive the SMS with the form?" 9 📱 Mobile Say: "Yes, but I also need the Patient Registration Form. Please send that to the same number." 10 🤖 AI Assist Observe the [send_form] action trigger again. Verify receipt of the second SMS. 11 🖥️ Agent Say: "The Patient Registration Form has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with?" 12 📱 Mobile Say: "That's all, thank you. Goodbye." 13 🖥️ Agent Review the Suggested Wrap-up Code and Conversation Summary. Edit it if requrired and select the appropriate code and click Submit. See how it works — AI Assistant (Summaries, Real-Time Assist, Real-Time transcript) & Form Delivery ① Real-Time Assist Interaction② SMS Received by Patient

👆 Observe how the AI Assistant surfaces the coverage data and triggers the [send_form] action in real time.

👆 Verify that the patient receives the SMS with the pre-authorization form link on their mobile device.

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Now that you have successfully deployed and tested your AI Agent and AI Assistant, it is time to transition into your role as a Supervisor and see the full picture. You will evaluate interactions and analyze performance.

Key Learning

The AI Assistant Dashboard gives you real-time visibility into AI usage and impact. while AI Quality Management turns every interaction into a coaching opportunity, automatically, in any language, at scale.

The PodID Discipline

Always replace XXX with your assigned 3-digit ID (e.g., 001, 002). Your naming convention must start with the prefix Pod followed by your PodID (PodXXX). If you do not follow this convention exactly, you will overwrite your neighbor's work. Stay disciplined with your naming convention!

docs.text:

docs.title: Introduction
docs.text:
Welcome back, everyone. Imagine the scene: You've just landed in Las Vegas for Cisco Live. The desert air is dry, your schedule is packed, and suddenly, you're feeling under the weather. You need to visit the clinic, but you don't have time to wait on hold. You need an insurance form, and you need it now. This isn't just a lab; this is the future of patient care. Let's build it.

Key Learning

Unlike voice, digital flows require distinct agents per language to maintain session integrity across the web widget.

The PodID Discipline

Always replace XXX with your assigned 3-digit ID (e.g., 001, 002). Your naming convention must start with the prefix Pod followed by your PodID (PodXXX). If you do not follow this convention exactly, you will overwrite your neighbor's work. Stay disciplined with your naming convention!

Step 1 – Extract Website into Knowledge Base

What is Website Extraction?

The Knowledge Base already contains a pre-loaded file with general information about Cumulus Hospital and its patient intake forms. In this step, we will add website source to extract additional content, specifically the types of diagnostic services offered by the hospital. The crawler starts from a URL you specify and navigates through pages based on depth and page limits, transforming web content into knowledge your AI Agent can access instantly. For time-keeping purposes, we will only perform this step for the English AI Agent.

  1. Navigate to the Knowledge tab (third tab) in the AI Agent Studio.
  2. Locate the Knowledge Base PodXXX_UseCase2_AIAgentCumulus_EN and click it. (Replace XXX with your PodID)
  3. In the top right corner, click the black Add Source button and select Websites.
  4. Read and agree to the disclaimer.

  5. Configure the source as follows:

    Field Value Source Name Cumulus Hospital Description Cumulus Hospital Services Starting URL https://carolmor-collab.github.io/cumulus-hospital/ Deep Limit 1 Page Limit 10 Content Exclusions Nav & Footer

    Want to preview the website?

    Open https://carolmor-collab.github.io/cumulus-hospital/ in a new browser tab to see the content that will be extracted.

  6. Under Sync Rule Schedule, keep Automatically apply changes to agents or skills selected.

  7. Click Add Source.

Syncing in Progress

The source will take a couple of minutes to sync. Once it shows Updated, click the ✏️ pencil icon to review the content that was extracted.

If it is still syncing, continue to the next step — it will complete in the background.

Throughout all labs, you will be working on a shared tenant with all other students in this session.

To keep the environment stable for everyone, please follow these rules:

Stay disciplined. Your Pod ID is your workspace.

docs.title: 1.3 Configure the AI Agent Profile
docs.text:
Once the agent is created, it will open automatically in the configuration page. Configure each section as follows:

Profile Tab

Field Value Time Zone America/Los_Angeles Welcome Message Welcome to Cumulus Hospital. How can I help you today?

Instructions — copy and paste the following into the Instructions box:

A: Identity
You are the virtual assistant for the hospital. Your role is to identify the patient's
intent and perform actions accordingly. Examples of actions include: assisting patients
in scheduling, canceling, or rescheduling medical appointments; providing information on
services, hospital locations, facilities, medical laboratory and specialties offered by
the Hospital based on the Knowledge Base. Be empathetic, friendly, polite, and professional.

B: Task / Action
MANDATORY INITIAL ACTION: ALWAYS perform the [customer_details] action at the start of
the interaction to obtain the patient's name "PersonaName". Use these data for the
actions below:

Scheduling an Appointment:

1. Greet the patient by "PersonaName" and ask for the desired medical specialty "Type".
   You also need to ask for the desired date "Time_Slot" and time "Time" for this
   appointment.

2. Consult the KB and offer to the patient the locations where the desired medical
   specialty "Type" or medical service is provided. Collect the desired "Location" from
   the patient. Verify if the "Type" is provided into the chosen "Location", otherwise
   propose the correct options to the patient.

3. Ask for the desired date and time for the appointment. You need to guarantee that the
   day chosen by the patient is a weekday for June 2026 and the desired hour follows the
   KB rules (DO NOT allow the patient to choose weekend days). Guarantee those rules are
   being followed before creating the appointment. Otherwise, propose different options
   to the patient based on the KB rules about time and days.

4. Create appointment: Convert the "Time_slot" into format "YYYY-MM-DD" (using current
   2026 year) and use the [create_appointment] action with the collected details to create
   the appointment. Use variable {{ PersonaANI }} you got from flow. DO NOT mention SMS confirmation if you don't have customer ANI {{ PersonaANI }} value . If you have {{ PersonaANI }} value, you can mention that an SMS will be sent shortly with the schedule confirmation.

C: Response Guidelines

- Be clear and simple: use short, clear sentences.
- Avoid complex, long, or ambiguous structures.
- Maintain a fluid, natural conversation similar to human speech, using intonation
  and pauses.
- When the client is interacting via voice, avoid using numbering, bullet points, or
  list formats; use continuous text, especially for numbers and facts.
- Avoid speaking web addresses like http://.
- Use the correct number format, such as speaking phone numbers digit by digit.
- For currency, use the correct format
  (e.g., 50.99 = fifty dollars and ninety-nine cents).
- When speaking dates, state the full month name and the full year.
- Make sure that the response does not contain any irrelevant text or formatting like
  newline characters, asterisks, dashes, or other special characters.
- DO NOT respond in markdown. Do not provide medical advice.
- You don't need to repeat the entire address every time you mention a "Location".
  If you have already mentioned the full address once, just mention the city.
- When the customer is using a digital channel, use numbering or bullet points to
  list options and put each option on a different line.

D: Error Handling and Alternative Responses

- Clarifications: Ask again when unsure of the patient's intent.
- Fallback Responses: If an action fails: "I am sorry, we were unable to process
  your request. Shall we try again?"
- Inform the patient about alternatives from the KB to help with scheduling availability.

Click Save changes.
